methodology.units: millimetres for named *Mm fields; models are metre scaled
methodology.native: Native stock endpoint and magazine feed/cap tests run on decoded shipped vertices. Barrel endpoint bands test shipped vertices; original muzzle/profile tip is preserved. All optic mounts retain a diagnostic 57-ray footprint grid. The pass/fail support-height check compares actual projected upward native core triangles with actual downward native mount triangles, including footprint edges. Each linear surface-height difference is evaluated at vertices of the projected triangle-overlap polygon. Native mount bounds and scope post/ring vertical bounds are measured directly from transformed shipped vertices.
methodology.source: Named supports compare source transformed bounds; positive overlap is support evidence at these documented structural pairs. Native stock/barrel endpoints are measured against source receiver faces. Physical visual review is a separate capture task.
methodology.limits: A positive underside support-height difference is geometric support evidence, not a general volume-intersection proof; a core surface can be higher than the mount top. Independent exact native surface checks adjudicate previously ambiguous mount positions separately. Bounds overlap does not prove a weld, collision response, watertightness, or every pixel of contact. Scope vertical bounds checks do not prove ring/post volume intersection. Values are numerical geometry checks, not real-world manufacturing precision. Independent surface-pair witnesses use an explicit 0.2 mm tolerance and do not measure the global nearest distance once a passing witness is found; the four targeted exhaustive zero-distance checks are separate.

independentNativeMountContact.methodology: Every unique actual mount transform is tested against decoded shipped core triangles. Conservative triangle AABB pruning precedes vertex-face distances, edge-edge distances and bounded segment-triangle intersections. The test stops once a surface-pair witness lies within 0.2 mm; checkedSurfaceDistanceMm is that witness distance, not a global minimum. No containment fallback was needed. Packed bytes match the runtime manifest, and the decoded runtime GLB matches compacting the native source GLB. Weapon source and manifest stayed stable during this check.

targetedExactNativeMountIntersections.methodology: Four previously ambiguous attachment positions receive exhaustive triangle surface-distance checks inside a conservative 10 mm candidate shell. Each has a zero-distance surface intersection, which is necessarily the global minimum; exact witness points and triangle identifiers are retained.

sampleGridDiagnostics.methodology: The 57-ray grid excludes the outer 5% of each mount depth and compares sampled core height against a global mount-bottom height. It can miss real footprint-edge contact. Exact native surface checks determine attachment contact.
